To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the addition of SWCNT to an epoxy resin improves its interfacial strength, and that this improvement can be explained by an increase in shear yield stress of epoxy and the increase of interfacial radial pressure due to thermal residual stress.
SWCNT-epoxies can be used to reinforce fibre composites.
the interfacial shear strength of the carbon fibre-epoxy composite increases after introducing SWNTs in the matrix.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the interfacial shear stress distribution in the fibre-matrix interface and the residual strains in the vicinity of a single carbon fibre in the epoxy matrix.
the interfacial properties of the SWCNT-epoxies and the carbon fibre - SWCNT-epoxide nanocomposite.
the interfacial properties between the carbon fibre and the epoxy matrix, and the effect of carbon nanotubes (CNTs) on the interface.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presence of carbon nanotubes in the epoxy matrix has a reinforcing effect on the fibre-matrix interface, and the interfacial shear stress distribution is affected by the fibre length.
SWCNT reinforcement can improve the interface strength of carbon fibre reinforced composite.
SWCNTs play a reinforcement role at the interface between the fibre and the matrix.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the SWCNT-epoxies are promising matrix materials for carbon fibre reinforced composites.
the SWCNT reinforcement role is not limited to the matrix material.
SWCNT can improve the interfacial shear strength of carbon fibre reinforced composites.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the SWCNTs are effective in reinforcing the interfacial region of the composite.
SWCNT can be used to improve the interfacial properties of carbon fibres in composites.
the SWCNTs can be used as an effective interfacial reinforcement to increase the interfacial strength and improve the mechanical properties of the carbon fibres.
